name: Rice sheets with pork offal
summary: Fine rice-noodle sheets brushed with scallion fat, served with pork heart, liver, blood sausage, and intestine, herbs, and chili fish sauce, often with a bowl of blood-and-pork porridge.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey, in the coastal half of the post-merger province.
howToEat: Eat the sheets with the offal, herbs, and chili fish sauce. The porridge cooked with blood and minced pork is the side the article names.
where: The coastal half of the province, former Bình Định.
seoDescription: Bánh hỏi lòng heo is fine rice sheets with scallion fat and pork offal, herbs, and chili fish sauce, with a blood-porridge side. A coastal Gia Lai plate.
